title: Project current origin observations into deterministic resolution input
objective: Add a read-only, deterministic projection from approved current database observation records into the SI-022A origin inventory resolution contract and emit an inspectable review artifact without writing to the database or changing source, connector, scheduler, candidate, or gate state.
product_value: Turn the implemented origin-resolution state machine into a usable current-truth diagnostic for the Pipeline while preserving review-only and no-mutation boundaries.
definition_of_ready: SI-022A is merged and its deterministic engine and runner are available.
Current database claims are accessed through existing approved read-only repository patterns.
The slice does not require provider judgment, connector activation, scheduler mutation, candidate mutation, or database writes.
definition_of_done: Approved current observation records are mapped into the immutable SI-022A candidate and external-signal contracts.
Missing or contradictory read-model fields produce an explicit blocked or needs-inspection result rather than guessed values.
The projection produces an inspectable deterministic JSON artifact suitable for review and later Daily Runner integration.
No database write, proposal-table write, provider call, connector registration, source activation, scheduler change, candidate creation, or gate mutation is possible from this slice.
Generated regression tests cover at least one confirmed origin, one unresolved or dormant case, and malformed or incomplete read-model evidence.
Targeted tests, the full repository test suite, and Ruff pass.
